business_summary.text: Sanginita Chemicals Limited is a Gujarat-based manufacturer and supplier of chemicals operating in a single chemical business segment.

capital_actions.instrument: Share swap to B N G Investment LLC

history.progress: members approved on 11 April 2026; NSE in-principle approval applied for

deals.progress: members approved on 11 April 2026; NSE in-principle approval applied for

auditor_history.name: B. K. Chavda & Co. LLP
auditor_history.note: Unmodified opinion on the audited results for the year ended 31 March 2026; firm converted from partnership to LLP with effect from 3 April 2026

penalties.authority: National Stock Exchange of India Limited
penalties.details: NSE has imposed penalty of Rs. 9440/- (including GST) for delay in submission for Shareholding Pattern under Regulation 31 of SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015

operating_notes.text: FY26 raw material cost fell 32.1% to ₹89.26 Cr while purchases of stock-in-trade rose 2.8% to ₹91.97 Cr, so traded goods cost more than own materials.
FY26 operating cash flow of ₹15.57 Cr came mainly from a ₹10.23 Cr debtor release and ₹10.61 Cr inventory release, not from operations.
Dipakkumar B. Chavda ceased to be CFO and Sangitaben D. Chavda was appointed as CFO.
Formed a committee of independent directors comprising Mr. Pramodsinh Dabhi, Mr. Jagdishkumar Vajaji Thakor, Mr. Sanmitra Trivedi and Ms. Jalpa Anand Lavingia for the open offer.
Received a ₹106.04 Cr solar EPC and O&M contract for a 47.8 MW project from step-down subsidiary IMC Solar BDN LLP.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹42.97 Cr (-13.8% YoY), net loss ₹6.33 Cr (against a loss of ₹0.05 Cr a year earlier).
Dipakkumar B. Chavda resigned as CFO effective April 25, 2026, and Sangitaben D. Chavda was appointed as CFO.
Sanginita Chemicals constituted a committee of independent directors to evaluate the open offer for 26% of its equity.
Sanginita Chemicals released the Letter of Offer for the open offer by B N G Investment LLC and Anubhav Agarwal.
Agastya Energy and Infrastructure received a solar EPC and O&M contract worth ₹106.04 Cr from its step-down subsidiary IMC Solar BDN LLP.

watchlist.text: NSE in-principle approval for the preferential issue and share swap
All applicable approvals for the SSSPA and preferential allotment
